notes.title: What are the problems and how did they happen

items.text: According to your feedback, we've noticed some issues mainly related to environmental lighting, shadows, special effects, and character models. These glitches could really mess with the immersion factor for players.

The issues arose due to our transition from the previous rendering pipeline, known as Built-in, to the URP (Universal Render Pipeline). However, this switch led to significant disparities in the visual aesthetics of Sandrock due to differences in how the pipelines handle lighting and other aspects. Unfortunately, we failed to promptly and comprehensively optimize the art to align with the characteristics of the new pipeline. This oversight on our part has hindered the gaming experience, and we sincerely apologize for the issue. Rest assured, addressing these graphic art issues is our top priority as a development team, as we are committed to ensuring that every player can fully immerse themselves in our game.
We've looked into the issues reported by you and our art team has been hard at work fixing things up. Here's what's been improved so far:
'Left' is before ---- Right will be the 'after'

The showcased improvements just present parts of our progress, and Ambient Occlusion (AO) and other effects will be further fine-tuned. Due to space limitations, we couldn't cover every detail, but we've selected some key fixes with representative screenshots.

Regarding the fixes mentioned, we're planning to package and test them for a week or two. If everything goes smoothly, these fixes will be rolled out as a maintenance patch either next week or the following one.
In the near future, we'll also add graphic brightness and contrast settings for you to adjust based on your preferences. (P.S. The UI will be further fine-tuned.)

We'll keep working based on your feedback. After the update, if you spot any other art-related issues, please reach out to us through the official channels listed below. Your feedback helps us identify and fix these problems more effectively.

The Chinese New Year flew by so fast, and it's already time for us to update everyone on our recent work. Lately, our main challenge has been ensuring that content updates are synchronized across all platforms. This task hasn't been easy, and we'll explain the details below.

The new V1.3.0 free quarterly update and the new paid pet DLC are currently in progress, and things are going smoothly so far. For now, we've already completed all the basic features, and we just have some finishing touches left, such as adding special effects and sound effects. We plan to work with some players from the community to assist with beta testing in mid to late March, while also working on porting and optimizing for other console platforms. If everything goes well, we should be able to release it to everyone by mid to late April.

Of course, there's also the content of the free quarterly update to look forward to, such as the brand new "Sand Buggy Circuit" mini-game! You'll be able to drive race cars found in the Catori World and challenge your in-game NPC friends to an exciting speed competition!

Remember when we teased about hitching a ride on the 'Rambo' after tying the knot with Logan? You guys were stoked to catch a glimpse of this flying beauty, so here's a cool pic of Builder riding on the 'Rambo'! And guess what? Rambo is leveling up to become a 'two-seater mount'! You know what that stands for. But hey, what will it look like exactly? Well, saddle up and find out for yourselves!

The Switch version 1.2.2, also known as "New Year, Better Me," is about to receive an update. We apologize for keeping Switch players waiting for so long, but we assure you, this wait will be worth it. In the upcoming update, we've made almost all possible optimizations, focusing on graphics and performance. For instance, the optimized version now achieves a basic FPS of nearly 28-30 frames (the early 20 hours will almost maintain 30 fps), with significant enhancements in UI loading speed, asset quality, shadow distance, grass color, and gradients. notes.title: Fun Facts of Chinese New Year

items.text: Chinese New Year, or the Spring Festival, is a cherished tradition in China, marking the start of the lunar new year between January 21st and February 20th. It's a time for family reunions and cultural festivities, featuring rituals, dragon dances, lantern displays, and vibrant fireworks. Red, symbolizing luck, dominates the celebrations. People exchange good wishes such as 'wealth,' 'happiness,' and 'luck' for blessings and prosperity. Chinese families also adorn their homes with Spring Festival couplets, which are poetic phrases expressing good fortune and happiness. Fireworks further illuminate the night sky, adding a dazzling spectacle to the festivities, believed to chase away negative forces and welcome the new year with a burst of positive energy.
The festive atmosphere brims with hope and joy for a prosperous new year. We wish you a great Chinese New Year in Sandrock!

items.text: Howdy Builders!
We're upgrading our version numbering system to enhance clarity across all platforms. Let's take V1.2.3.4 as an example as an example,

The first number ‘1’ is the major version, kicking off with V1.0 as the official release. If a significant update comes next summer, like cross-platform multiplayer, it could be V2.0. Until then, it's V1.x.
The second number ’2‘ signals new content based on the previous version. So, if the next update adds more cool stuff, it might become V1.2, V1.3, and so on.

The third number ‘3’ is for monthly fixes. Think of it as regular housekeeping—no new content, just tweaking and improving. This happens about once a month. If V1.2.3 is out, the next month might bring a maintenance update, making it V1.2.4.
The fourth number ‘4’ is for emergency bug fixes. If something needs a quick fix after a release, they add a number here.
So, V1.2.3.4 means after V1.0, there were two updates with new things, followed by three regular monthly tune-ups. After the third tune-up, there were four quick bug fixes.
This change aims to provide a straightforward understanding of updates and ensure consistency across all platforms, promoting more efficient communication for everyone.

releases.displayName: What To Expect In The Major Update 'Logan Strikes Back!' | Part 3

items.text: The "Logan strikes back!" update is less than two weeks away! Check out some of the new content coming on Aug 30th.

We have added new side quests for some NPCs, and you'll be able to learn more about their pasts. With more storytelling, you will be able to uncover more about the lives of your fellow desert dwellers, such as Fang. It should be great to discover more secrets mined deep within Fang through more new side quests.

The social system has been updated, allowing you to choose your favorite in-town character, approach, play/date, and romance them (Eligible in-town characters are romanceable, except for Fang, but you can interact with Fang and gift him now). In the meantime, more townsfolk are now available to romance now, e.g. Unuusur and Catori. Though the marriage will be added to the game later this year, once you accumulate enough relationship points to be able to become engaged once you'll have the option to get married when that update arrives later this year.

Additionally, we have a new holiday in Sandrock. Do you remember which day Portia had the hotpot party? This holiday will be coming to Sandrock too! However, it will be different in a special Sandrock way! All we can say is the fire, food, and....sauces. Come and find out for yourself on Aug 30th.

items.text: Our wish is… to get the certification that we've been waiting for to release Sandrock! Hahaha! We hope that it’ll happen very soon. In the meantime, we have some new content to share with you!
More Side Quests
With new quests added, we‘re getting to learn more about Sandrock residents. Making friends and hanging out with them makes for a fun, memorable time in Sandrock!
Ernest Makes His Appearance
Let’s welcome the first of the two 400K wishlist goal NPCs arriving in Sandrock: Ernest, who is an author from Atara and intrigued by Logan’s tale! What tales of his own will he spin?
More Recipes

Now, fresh new Sandrock dishes are waiting for you to discover! You can cook up combinations of raw ingredients to figure recipes out yourself or learn them from the locals. Just ask others about their recipes to build camaraderie and perhaps learn a new dish that can be enjoyed for its benefits or presented as a lovely gift to another Sandrocker!
New Powerful Machines

Like in Portia, Fire-Powered Generators can provide power to other machines! They’re a secret weapon for Builders to manage their machines efficiently and can boost workshop productivity. And the new Sorting Machine will help you get precious stones/minerals from common rocks.
Breakable Chests

A pro Builder should always try to make use of the materials around them. Of course treasures are hidden in chests, but don’t forget, chests themselves are useful things! Now you can break them down to use as resources!

And there are more things that are optimized or added, such as the tweaked quicksave function and the new hairstyles, outfits, bunny hutch, etc. The full list of changes will be available in the changelist soon.
As always, thanks for your support! Whatever you celebrate, may your holidays be happy and safe~

items.text: The beta is going to update soon! Let’s see what’s new here and what we worked on, and what things will become playable this month.

We thought the old version of sandfishing didn’t do a good job of depicting fishing in the sands, so we went ahead and complete remade it. Sandfishing now allows Builders to fish for more than one fish at once, but managing the type of bait is important, as different baits attracts different fish. The trap also plays a bigger role in the gameplay, as upgraded traps help you catch fish much easier. You’ll throw your bait in first, and then you’ll be able to see fish moving in the quicksand pitch! Observation is still the key: more or fewer fish, valuable or cheap fish, all up to your skills!
More NPCs' side quests are added, lovely Sandrock residents come to you to tell their backstories.
-New Interiors of Qi's research center
The new research center’s interior decoration is done. Here's Qi, very comfortable with the new place. Look, he is thinking about something to research now!
-New Fang's Clinic
X: "Squawk! I like the new home, Doctor can take care of your health, health, health~"

With the new clinic done, you’ll have a new activity you can do with Fang. He will send you an invitation to your mailbox and ask for your help with an experiment. But experiments might bring unexpected results. Sometimes, you’ll get buffed with fine medicine, other times, you’ll suffer some funky side effects...

Are you tired of mining personally? Now you can hire someone to help you! Sign a contract with the Salvage company and hire Rocky and his crew to mine for you and get recyclable scraps. We hope this can save a bit of your time and effort for getting resources.
Introducing: the Refiner! If you want your items to be of higher quality, this is the crafting machine to get!
Guard up and get ready to bob and weave! More monsters are in Sandrock, so be careful while exploring the wild, wild world. The Boxing Jack is just one of them, and there's more to discover!
A new set of explorer-style outfits has been added. Tactical gear for exploring ruins and kicking monster butt!
Which of these are you most excited for? Comment to let us know!
And more details to come in the changelist.
